description: Source code for an alternator controller in a vehicle engine management system, including control logic, thread management, and configuration handling.

methods.name: AltCtrlThread
methods.description: Main thread function controlling alternator operation, including PID regulation and on/off logic.

methods.name: showAltInfo
methods.description: Displays current alternator control status and parameters.

methods.name: setAltPFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for the alternator PID controller.

methods.name: applyAlternatorPinState
methods.description: Applies a PWM or on/off state to the alternator control pin.

methods.name: setDefaultAlternatorParameters
methods.description: Initializes default parameters for the alternator control system.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeAlternatorCallback
methods.description: Handles configuration changes related to the alternator control, resetting PID if needed.

methods.name: initAlternatorCtrl
methods.description: Initializes the alternator control subsystem, setting up threads and pins.
